input.summary: Remove the three-year take-or-pay minimum and confirm fees are payable only for usage or ordered Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts § 12.3's confirmation that we have given no minimum-volume commitment. We have replaced § 2.1 with our preferred position that there is no minimum commitment and we pay only for usage or ordered Services; if a commitment is essential, our fallback is one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment and pays only for usage or Services ordered under an Order Form.
